notes: Borsanyi et al. (arXiv:1606.07494, Nature 539 (2016) 69): lattice QCD calculation of the equation of state and topological susceptibility chi(T), used to PREDICT the dark matter axion mass (post-inflation scenario: strict lower bound m_A = 28(2) ueV; headline prediction m_A = 50-1500 ueV, Figure 3). This is a theory prediction, not an experimental exclusion on any coupling. The Supplementary Information (Section S12, Fig. S31) shows the m_A vs C_Agamma plane with existing limits from OTHER experiments (ADMX, RBF, UF, CAST) and sensitivity projections/proposals (G2, G3, IAXO, dish antenna, dielectric-mirror haloscope, i.e. the MADMAX precursor proposal), but the paper derives no new measured limit of its own. Hence is_new_limit=false; flagged is_projection=true because the paper's only exclusion-plane content is proposals/sensitivity forecasts; no data points reported.
